headline.caveat: described only as 'multibillion-dollar'; exact value undisclosed

nature_md: Multibillion-dollar, multi-year agreement (announced Nov 3, 2025) for Lambda to deploy AI infrastructure for Microsoft powered by tens of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, including GB300 NVL72 systems. Extends a >8-year Microsoft–Lambda relationship and positions Lambda as one of Microsoft's strategic external capacity suppliers alongside CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, and IREN. Value undisclosed — one of the weakest-disclosed edges in the Microsoft neocloud complex.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Committed capacity purchases expensed as consumed; part of Microsoft's ~$60B+ rented-neocloud strategy layered on top of its ~$190B CY26 capex plan.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Contracted revenue/backlog for Lambda (private; no public RPO disclosure), supporting its GPU-backed financing and mooted IPO. Adds a second hyperscaler-scale anchor after its existing cloud business.
